task.title: Allocating the monies — Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction

step.cmd: Refer to Extension of the benefit period before proceeding to step 3.
In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Remarks line 1: Type “Input M175 [C, S or V] - XXXX$ (amount to allocate) from XXXX (first day of allocation) to XXXX (last day of allocation), XXXX$(amount to be allocated on last week if different).”

Remarks line 2 (to be used if top-up amount is to be input): Type “Input M175 [C, S or V] - XXXX$ (amount to allocate) from XXXX (first day of allocation) to XXXX (last day of allocation), XXXX$ (amount to be allocated on last week if different).”
Remarks line 4: Enter the information about the BP extension, if necessary. Info
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: To transfer the registration number to IPOC, select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send a D-20-16-03 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Allocations of Earnings (2516): Select the appropriate option:
Allocation of earnings - Only from ROE #1, Monies allocated beyond BPC
Allocation of earnings - Monies allocated beyond BPC are from both ROE #1 and ROE #2
$0.00 - Total amount of earnings received from employment - ROE#1 (1102): Enter the total amount of WEPP separation monies allocated.
Type of Earnings (2519)
Monies received from your employer/employers/Employer’s name - ROE #1 (2520): Select Text: Employer’s name - ROE#1 .
Text - Name of Employer(s) (1502): Type “the Wage Earner Protection Program.”
First week of allocation of earnings - Sunday’s date - ROE #1 (1088)
Last week of allocation of earnings - Saturday’s date - ROE #1 (1090)

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the previous task.
